note.question: How should a fundamental model of resource allocation in which a finite number of resources be assigned in an online manner to a heterogeneous stream of customers?
note.overview: This paper studies a fundamental model of resource allocation in which a finite number of resources must be assigned in an online manner to a heterogeneous stream of customers. The customers arrive randomly over time according to known stochastic processes. Each customer requires a specific amount of capacity and has a specific preference for each of the resources with some resources being feasible for the customer and some not.

source.quote: We study a fundamental model of resource allocation in which a finite number of resources must be assigned in an online manner to a heterogeneous stream of customers.
